verdict.rationale: Sift is a fraud-detection SaaS platform, so shipping an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents only REST APIs, a JS snippet, mobile SDKs and curl-based API examples, and none of these is an official Sift CLI. curl is a third-party tool, and APIs and SDKs are developer building blocks, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
